jared: Heads-up: townhall this Friday 9:30am PT. Plan ~40m. Please drop quick Qs here or use the anonymous form. We'll collect and prioritize for the live slot. :calendar: 

nina: High-level agenda below. Rao and I will do two short demos: optimized batching + rollout canary metrics.

rao: Demo ask: engineering, paste one recent perf/regression example you want surfaced. 30s show & tell.

emily: Note for managers: bring one hiring ask and one cross-team blocker for the 2-min roundtable. No names in public threads.

nina: Agenda draft:
```
1) 9:30-9:40 Exec update (Jared) 
2) 9:40-9:50 Demos: batching optimizer + canary metrics (Rao, Nina)
3) 9:50-10:00 Policy brief: retention opt-in + audit exports (Emily)
4) 10:00-10:05 Roadblocks roundtable (managers)
5) 10:05-10:10 Live Q&A (prioritized)
```

jared: Quick bullets I'll cover: market traction, hiring plan, and the Dedicated rollout timeline.

rao: For the canary demo I'll show the new fallback route and latency histogram. If anyone has a short log snippet that shows the prior failure mode, paste it here.

emily: Policy brief will include the new standard retention (180 days) and the enterprise opt-in. I'll paste a short FAQ + matrix before the meeting.

allhands_bot: Recording link will be posted here after the event. Slides + TL;DR to follow. :white_check_mark:

qa_form_bot: Anonymous Qs: https://forms.gle/RedwoodTownhallAnon 

nina: Can we please keep Qs short in the form — we only have ~5 minutes for live questions. We'll answer follow-ups in the product sync doc.

jared: If you can't make it, still add Qs. We'll surface top ones live and follow up with written answers.

rao: Engineering folks: call out any customer-facing regressions or latency spikes. Example shorthand: "embed endpoint 99p latency spike after 2024-11-02 deploy".

emily: Reminder: meeting recorded; if you need slides embargoed for a partner announcement, DM me.

nina: I'll push the calendar update in 10m with the agenda and dial-in. Please RSVP so we can estimate Q time.

jared: TL;DR for people skimming: Friday 9:30am PT, demos + policy update + quick Qs. Recording + notes posted to #all-hands after.

rao: Thanks all. See you Friday. Paste demo snippets here if you want them included. :rocket:
